headline: Stlican Shelf Rekindles and Viper Pit Surges Under Heavy Clashes
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, fighting has flared intensely on Stlican Shelf, which registered eight base transitions over the past two hours around Breaker Town and The Pale House following an earlier lull. Viper Pit has likewise surged in violence, recording five rapid base events and over seven hundred casualties in two hours as contention over Blackthroat sharpens. In the center, Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse maintain relentless friction, logging seven combined base shifts in two hours amid heavy fighting at The First Coin and Wightwalk. Further west, Callahan's Passage is sustaining severe casualty acceleration with over eleven hundred losses in two hours, even as front-line ownership held steady. Activity has largely settled in Marban Hollow and cooled in Fishermans Row, though Stonecradle logged two fresh shifts and Isle of Psyche in Tempest Island recently fell into no-man's-land.
